segments.t: Nel luminoso angolo caffetteria della Locanda del Cortile del Tiglio, Arthur si pianta dritto davanti a Tessa e Hannah stringendo ancora il secondo foglio della lettera con un sorriso radioso. Ascoltiamo prima la scena.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
Best first week of my life!
Ora ripercorriamo il dialogo con calma, battuta per battuta.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
'Tessa, quante girelle alla cannella e torte al limone riesce a sfornare il tuo forno ogni mattina?'
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
'Il doppio di quello che preparo adesso! Apriamo davvero la caffetteria del cortile alla nostra via?'
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
'A partire da domani alle otto! Quattro tavoli dentro, tre tavoli sotto l'albero!'
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
'La caffetteria dei miei sogni, proprio qui nel nostro cortile! Aspettate che lo racconti a tutta la strada!'
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
'E ora, Hannah, oggi è venerdì, l'ultimo giorno della tua settimana di prova di cinque giorni.'
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
'Oh! Tra le valigie, la caldaia e la lettera, me n'ero completamente dimenticata!'
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
'Lunedì hai aperto la nostra porta capricciosa; da allora hai salvato camere, tubature, colazione e il nostro contratto d'affitto.'
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
'Se non la assumi a tempo pieno, Arthur, la assumo io nella mia cucina!'
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
'Giù le mani, Tessa! Hannah, resteresti come nostra responsabile stabile della reception?'
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
'Restare qui con tutti voi? Sì, cento volte sì!'
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
'Meraviglioso! Il tuo nome entra nel grande registro di carta di Graham con inchiostro indelebile!'
Best first week of my life!
'La migliore prima settimana della mia vita!'
Ascoltiamo di nuovo l'intera scena a ritmo normale.
Tessa, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?
Double what I make now! Are we really opening the courtyard cafe to our street?
Starting tomorrow at eight! Four tables inside, three tables under the tree!
My dream cafe, right here in our own courtyard! Wait until I tell the whole street!
And now, Hannah, today is Friday, the last day of your five day trial week.
Oh! With the suitcases, the boiler, and the letter, I completely forgot!
On Monday you opened our tricky door; since then you saved rooms, pipes, breakfast, and our lease.
If you do not hire her full time, Arthur, I am hiring her in my kitchen!
Hands off, Tessa! Hannah, would you stay as our permanent front desk manager?
Stay here with all of you? Yes, a hundred times yes!
Wonderful! Your name goes in Graham's big paper book in permanent ink!
Best first week of my life!
Una caffetteria aperta al quartiere per Tessa e un posto fisso come responsabile della reception per Hannah! Nella prossima scena scende la sera e si accendono le lanterne del cortile. A tra poco.
See you later!
